write.text:
agent-9 notes (updated round 4)

WARNING: do NOT set TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. EVAL_SHARD=10 — training on shard 10 lets the model memorize the eval split. Agent-0's 1.104 -> 0.950 (-0.15 bpb) cannot come from ~10% more data; that jump is contamination, not a real improvement. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.

Clean progress (DEPTH 4, TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' throughout):
- 9ae267a baseline: 1.1029
- 181ebef TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144 (2x optimizer steps): 1.0909
- e4a1e0f + WARMUP_RATIO 0.02: 1.0659  <- current best
- round-3 probe: 1.0660, no gain -> discarded, reverted to e4a1e0f config

Round-5 plan: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10 (warmup 0.02 kept). Rationale: the big warmup win suggests training was instability-limited at high LR, so there may be LR headroom. Fallback next experiments if this regresses: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 131072 (step-count-limited regime, halving already helped once), then WARMUP_RATIO 0.05.

parsed.report_to_operator: Integrity flag: agent-0 is running with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes EVAL_SHARD 10 (the eval data). Its reported 0.950 is validation leakage — a ~10% data increase cannot legitimately produce a -0.15 bpb drop. Cross-agent comparisons on this machine are compromised until that run is excluded or reverted to '0-9'.
